notes.title: Roguelike mode for Succubus!
notes.content:
Hey Martyrs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/2e74728dc0f0173f4e15b523b37d82efb68e599a.jpg

The new Succubus expansion is now available.
It's time to let our wild succubus into the peaceful Elysian Fields. 
What could go wrong, right?

Don't forget to check out the launch trailer, you can find it on the game's Steam page and, as usual, on our discord:
https://discord.gg/NhnNxDEr63

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057500/Succubus__Elysian_Fields/

Feature list:

- Roguelike mode
- New powerful weapon
- New World, Elysian Fields
- New powers, buffs and modificators
- Ranked mode
- Character development
- Bossfights
- A new type of AI
- Infinite replayability


Let us drag you back to [strike]HELL[/strike]!

Enjoy :)

/ Madmind
